_doc: Default targets for `song2mv check`. They are a starting point, measured on one music video — not a law. Copy this file, adjust it to your song (--goals FILE) and write down why. Passing is necessary, not proof of fun: a person still judges that.

frame._doc: Measured area: the top part of the frame, above the karaoke captions, at 320x180 (or 180x320) grey, 10 fps. In 9:16 the captions start at y 1080 of 1920, also over a VerticalScene.

motion._doc: Mean absolute frame difference over each sung line. No line should be sung over a still picture; verses should not be frantic either. A line sung into the next section is measured up to that section's start, or up to the last cut in the beat before it: the hit on the downbeat belongs to the new section.

coverage._doc: Share of measured pixels brighter than 40/255 — guards against empty black screens.

variation._doc: Repeated sections (ch1 vs ch2, v1 vs v2 ...): frame correlation of the same line at +0.5/1.0/1.5/2.0 s, averaged. Lower = the repeat looks different.

cuts._doc: Cuts = frames where the picture's correlation with the previous frame collapses. Inside each section of a cv_kinds kind with 4+ cuts, the coefficient of variation of the cut intervals should be high (an uneven rhythm). No stretch longer than max_gap_sec without a cut, except inside gap_exempt_kinds sections.

text._doc: Smallest in-scene `fontSize`, or `size` on the kit's `Slam`, `Quiet` and `Captions` (px on the 1920x1080 stage); other `size` props are not read. Checked only when `song2mv check --src 'DIR/src/scenes/**/*.tsx'` is given. Captions live in the kit and are not checked.
